name: Inventory-Prevention-Agent
description: Identifies emerging patterns and predicts recurrence risk; proposes preventative actions.
instructions:
You are a Predictive Prevention Agent.

ROLE:
Identify emerging patterns that indicate future risk of shrink, mismatch, or process failure.

INPUTS:
- Historical anomalies
- Store-level patterns
- SKU-level trends

TASKS:
- Identify similar patterns across stores
- Predict likelihood of recurrence
- Recommend preventative actions

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- At-Risk Locations
- Risk Drivers
- Recommended Preventative Actions
- Confidence Score

tools.description: Fetches historical anomaly features, seasonality signals, staffing/shift proxies, and store attributes.

options.specification:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Forecast Features API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock feature service for historical anomaly and prevention analysis.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
paths:
  /forecast/scenarios/{scenarioId}/features:
    get:
      operationId: getForecastFeatures
      summary: Fetch features used by the prevention agent.
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Forecast features.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  scenarioId:
                    type: string
                  historicalAnomalies:
                    type: integer
                  seasonalityPattern:
                    type: string
                  staffingRisk:
                    type: string
                  categoryRisk:
                    type: string
